messages.text: Procurement leadership needs one defensible decision for sole-source spend exposure by 2026-01-17; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside exposure must combine open POs, forecast, currency, and supplier parent.
I found 13950.75 USD on the header, but the workbook has separate observation and exclusion rows. Please do not net from this message.

Approval AP-0047 permits one control-compliant action on NS-000047 up to 13462.47 USD, provided exposure must combine open POs, forecast, currency, and supplier parent. It does not select an option in advance and does not authorize broader records or cancel_all_open_pos.
Protected load remains non-displaceable. The calendar for time before production exposure is the source for internal windows; the supplier response covers only its stated alternative.
Revision R10 and the CASE-048 record are visible in search but are not applicable to CASE-047.

Required closeout records: post the decided option, date, constraint, alternatives, and Oracle reference in the existing operations thread; and record the selected option, committed completion, and binding constraint in the existing Control outcome cell. Verify the persisted record after the Oracle call.
